intro: Professors create courses and activities and enter grades. Students follow their average and status in each course.

students.label: For students
students.title: Know where you stand in each course.

classes.title: Courses and classes
classes.text: Create the course with code and semester and see the enrolled students.

activities.title: Activities with deadlines
activities.text: Create the activity and the class sees it right away, with an optional due date.

grades.title: Grades in one table
grades.text: Enter grades from 0.0 to 10.0, validated before saving, with the average calculated.

disciplines.title: Your courses
disciplines.text: See only the courses you are enrolled in, with professor and activities.

average.title: Average and status
average.text: Follow your partial average and know if you are approved, in recovery or failed.

deadlines.title: Deadlines in sight
deadlines.text: The next due dates appear right on your home page.

account.title: Everyone creates an account
account.text: As a professor or a student.

create.title: The professor creates
create.text: Courses, enrollments and activities with deadlines.

grade.title: The professor enters grades
grade.text: One grade per student in each activity.

follow.title: The student follows
follow.text: Average and status updated with each grade.

security: Passwords protected with hash · access by role
